name: GreenDeer
dex: Born with the 2019 Green Deal. A sprout shoots up every time an emissions standard is voted.

name: Fit55
dex: It trains to cut its emissions by 55% by 2030. It counts every calorie.

name: Neutralis
dex: It aims for carbon neutrality in 2050. Until then, it plants a tree with every step.

name: Coalbonnet
dex: A small heap of coal from the 1951 ECSC. It blackens everything it touches, enthusiastically.

name: Furnacio
dex: Its chimney spits sparks when it gets angry. It dreams of full employment.

name: Steelagon
dex: Forged in pooled coal and steel. It is proof that peace can be manufactured.

name: Atomino
dex: A curious little atom, born of the 1957 Euratom treaty. It can't sit still.

name: Euratome
dex: Its electrons spin so fast it lights up a whole room. Energy saving optional.

name: Fissionix
dex: It splits in two when it's upset. It and the Greens are no longer on speaking terms.

name: Stampon
dex: A living stamp that approves everything it meets. It has already stamped its own trainer.

name: Initialor
dex: It initials every page at the bottom right. It needs four hours per treaty.

name: Ratifix
dex: It only moves when 27 national parliaments have said yes. So it sleeps a lot.

name: Amendon
dex: It multiplies by the thousand with every bill. Parliament sometimes receives 2,000 per report.

name: Amendomax
dex: It tables so many amendments that it blocks the whole sitting. A well-honed technique.

name: Cookiz
dex: It has appeared in front of every door since the 2018 GDPR. Rejecting it is never enough.

name: Consentor
dex: It asks for your consent to everything, then for consent to the consent itself. It's very polite.

name: Usbeecee
dex: Mandatory on all devices since late 2024. It put a whole drawer of cables out of work.

name: Tethercap
dex: It hasn't left its bottle since July 2024. It hits your nose when you drink.

name: Strawraith
dex: Banned since 2021, it was thought extinct. It haunts fast-food restaurants at night.

name: Curvanana
dex: A 1994 regulation sets its quality. It spends its life measuring its own curvature.

name: Roamy
dex: It travels everywhere at no extra cost since June 2017. It calls its mum from every border.

name: Roamfree
dex: It visited all 27 countries in one weekend and live-posted everything. No surcharge.

name: Erasmouse
dex: This little rodent goes abroad for a semester and comes back bilingual. Born in 1987.

name: Erasmus+
dex: It has lived in 12 flatshares and cooks pasta in 9 languages.

name: Eurorolo
dex: A €2 coin that has rolled everywhere since 2002. It has 27 possible national sides.

name: Eurozone
dex: Twenty countries share its strength. When one coughs, the others get a fever.

name: Schengeon
dex: Born on a boat on the Moselle in 1985. No border can hold it back.

name: Glyphosaur
dex: Reauthorised for ten years in 2023. Weeds tremble as it passes.

name: Lobbyrax
dex: It roams the corridors with a briefcase bigger than itself. It doesn't lobby, it “informs”.

name: Lobbyron
dex: It knows the number of every parliamentary assistant. And their allergies.

name: Lobbyzilla
dex: One of Brussels' 25,000 lobbyists, in giant form. It rewrites laws in its sleep.

name: Transhumon
dex: An iron trunk that goes Brussels–Strasbourg twelve times a year. It gets travel sick.

name: Transhumax
dex: It carries an entire parliament in its belly. Cost of the trip: don't ask.

name: Clockback
dex: Parliament voted to abolish it in 2019. Yet it still comes back twice a year.

name: Dieselgate
dex: It has cheated on tests since 2015: clean on the test bench, smoky on the road.

name: Spitzen
dex: It campaigns for the presidency… then someone else is appointed instead.

name: Interpreton
dex: It speaks 24 languages, always with a two-second delay.

name: Trilogon
dex: Three heads: Parliament, Council, Commission. They reach agreement around 4 a.m.

name: Comitologist
dex: Nobody knows exactly what it does. Yet it sits on 300 committees.

name: Redtapor
dex: A pile of forms in triplicate. There's always one page missing.

name: Archivor
dex: It keeps everything, even sticky notes from 1958. Filing system: alphabetical and emotional.

name: Agricolo
dex: It gets a CAP payment for each hectare. It counts its hectares every morning.

name: CAPtor
dex: It swallows a third of the European budget without flinching. It's always hungry.

name: MegaCAP
dex: When it blocks the motorway with its tractors, even the Council negotiates.

name: Tractoron
dex: It parks in front of Parliament at every reform. Horn-honking guaranteed.

name: Cheeson
dex: A little raw-milk cheese that smells very strong. It's proud of its terroir.

name: PDOsaur
dex: Protected by a designation of origin. Any imitation is taken to court.

name: Pralino
dex: A very kind Belgian chocolate. It melts when you pay it a compliment.

name: Fryon
dex: Fried twice, as it should be. It flatly refuses to be called “French”.

name: Pigeonix
dex: It lives on Place du Luxembourg and steals lobbyists' fries. It knows all the gossip.

name: Manneken
dex: A little 55 cm statue with more costumes than the whole of Parliament.

name: Atomiom
dex: Nine steel spheres linked as a crystal, since Expo 58. It shines over Brussels at night.

name: Internix
dex: It works a lot and isn't paid. It says it's “a learning experience”.

name: Tempurion
dex: Its contract ends in three months. It has been renewing it for six years.

name: Tenuris
dex: It passed the EPSO competition. It fears nothing any more, except pension reform.

name: Grumbleon
dex: It's against. Against what doesn't matter, it's against.

name: Tribunon
dex: It climbs onto every table to harangue the crowd. Even in the canteen.

name: Demagogor
dex: It promises everything to everyone. Its promises evaporate at dawn.

name: Fakeon
dex: It changes shape depending on who's looking at it. It's very widely shared.

name: Trollbot
dex: A little robot that comments on everything in capitals. It has never slept.

name: Botfarm
dex: Ten thousand accounts in a single box. Elections know it well.

name: Algorithmo
dex: It learns from everything you do. It already knows what you're going to catch.

name: AIAct
dex: The world's first regulation on artificial intelligence (2024) brought it into line.

name: Inflaton
dex: It swells a little every month. Households keep a close eye on it.

name: Hyperflaton
dex: So big it blocks the streets. The ECB raises rates to make it slim down.

name: Spreadon
dex: It stretches with every clumsy statement by a central banker.

name: Cryptou
dex: It's worth a fortune in the morning and nothing at night. It loves roller coasters.

name: MiCA
dex: The MiCA regulation made it wear a tie. It's calmer now.

name: Austerix
dex: It never spends anything, not even its energy. Its cry: “Schwarze Null!”

name: Troicat
dex: Three cats: ECB, Commission, IMF. Together they inspect other people's accounts.

name: Vetoad
dex: A toad that croaks “no!” at every proposal. It takes just one to block everything.

name: Vetoadmax
dex: It demands unanimity for every decision, then refuses it itself.

name: Borderix
dex: It reappears whenever border checks are mentioned. It has its own sentry box.

name: Brexitt
dex: It wanted to leave in 2016, left in 2020, and sometimes regrets it. It often leaves battles.

name: Referendo
dex: A ballot box that asks simple questions about complicated problems.

name: Ghostaide
dex: Paid by Parliament, it has never set foot there. Nobody has ever seen it work.

name: Ghostjob
dex: It has a badge, a contract and a payslip. But no office.

name: Cashbag
dex: Found full of banknotes in a Brussels flat in December 2022.

name: Caseling
dex: A small suitcase that passes from hand to hand at the foot of Parliament.

name: Pipelino
dex: 1,200 km long under the sea. Its tap is controlled by someone else.

name: Windion
dex: Its blades spin as soon as you blow on it. It hates windless days.

name: Offshorion
dex: It lives off the North Sea coast and powers entire cities.

name: Solario
dex: It sleeps at night and works hard by day, especially in Spain.

name: Capnor
dex: It stops prices from rising too high. Its neck hurts from all the pushing.

name: Tariffix
dex: It taxes everything that passes in front of it. Even dead leaves.

name: Tariffator
dex: It brandishes a giant board of taxes. The figures change every morning.

name: Rarium
dex: A little pebble that every phone depends on. Its exports are being watched.

name: Pandiplo
dex: On loan to a European zoo for a few years. It eats bamboo and trade agreements.

name: Censorcub
dex: This yellow bear cub is not visible in any region. Its entry has been removed.

name: Kirchgeon
dex: It nests on the Court of Justice towers in Kirchberg and coos in Latin.

name: Schumark
dex: It recites the declaration of 9 May 1950 to anyone who will listen. It appears on Europe Day.

name: Nobelix
dex: A medal awarded to the European Union in 2012. It shines with pride.

name: Drizzels
dex: A little Brussels cloud. It rains on you 200 days a year.

name: Lunchix
dex: A three-hour working lunch. More gets decided there than in the chamber.

name: Mercosaur
dex: It has been under negotiation since 1999. When it takes one step forward, the tractors push it back.

name: Romulus
dex: Born on 25 March 1957 on the Capitol. It founded the European Economic Community.

name: Maastrix
dex: Born in the Netherlands in 1992. It created the Union and dreamed up the euro.

name: Lisbonia
dex: Signed in 2007, it took over most of a constitution that never saw the light of day.

name: Constitutio
dex: Rejected by referendum in France and the Netherlands in 2005. It flees as soon as you approach.

name: Draghizord
dex: It knows only one move, and it always succeeds. It saved the euro with one sentence.
